description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application supporting Wearable notifications. It handles initializing a list view, processing user input (including remote replies), and updating notifications based on user selection.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity of the app, responsible for displaying notification options and handling user replies.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and configures the list view with an adapter and click listener.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles intent results, particularly retrieving remote input replies and displaying a toast.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Builds and posts a notification based on the selected preset.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items, triggering notification updates.

methods.name: onTopEmptyRegionClick
methods.description: No operation; can be used to handle clicks on the empty area of the list.
